author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam's commission of an animatronic Grogu has involved a lot of work from a lot of collaborators off camera. But one thing Adam was able to do was move the electronics from the original FDM printed body to a new SLS body fresh out of the Formlabs Fuse. In this video, previously exclusive to our Tested Patron and Premium Members, Adam meticulously uninstalls and reinstalls the delicate electronics that make this particularly lovable character come to life! This is just one example of our Tested member videos.

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam unpacks the contents of his 1960's-era German medic's bag, sent to him from an overseas viewer. Not ony is this vintage leather bag beautifully constructed, but its numerous contents are preseved and fully intact for examination. Thanks to Haiko for sending this incredible piece of medical ephemera!

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
